from pathlib import Path
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

tasks = re.findall(r':[A-Za-z0-9_-]+:[A-Za-z0-9]+', Path('scripts/gradle-tasks.sh').read_text())
tasks += [':app:buildNative', ':torcore:buildTorNative', ':torcore:buildLyrebird', ':torcore:buildTorCoreJni']
statuses = ('UP-TO-DATE', 'FROM-CACHE', 'SKIPPED', 'NO-SOURCE', 'FAILED', 'UNKNOWN')
count = 0
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    log = Path(directory) / 'gradle.log'
    def check(name, changed, suffixes, expected, success=True):
        global count
        rows = ['> Task ' + task for task in tasks if task != changed]
        rows += ['> Task ' + changed + suffix for suffix in suffixes]
        log.write_text('\n'.join(rows + (['BUILD SUCCESSFUL'] if success else ['BUILD FAILED'])) + '\n')
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'tmp/session-merge-gradle-outcomes.py', str(log)],
                                capture_output=True, text=True)
        assert (result.returncode == 0) == expected, (name, changed, result.stderr)
        if expected:
            output = json.loads(log.with_name('forced-task-outcomes.json').read_text())
            assert set(output) == set(tasks)
        count += 1
    for task in tasks:
        check('single-executed', task, [''], True)
        check('resumed-output-header', task, ['', ''], True)
        check('multiple-resumed-headers', task, ['', '', ''], True)
        check('missing', task, [], False)
        for status in statuses:
            suffix = ' ' + status
            allowed = task == ':torcore-sample:testDebugUnitTest' and status == 'NO-SOURCE'
            check('single-' + status, task, [suffix], allowed)
            check('duplicate-' + status, task, [suffix, suffix], allowed)
            check('mixed-final-' + status, task, ['', suffix], False)
            check('mixed-initial-' + status, task, [suffix, ''], False)
        check('no-success-summary', task, [''], False, success=False)
    check('similar-task-is-not-target', ':app:buildNative', ['Extra'], False)
    captured = Path('tmp/session-auditor-failure-211144/gradle-forced-offline.log')
    log.write_bytes(captured.read_bytes())
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'tmp/session-merge-gradle-outcomes.py', str(log)],
                            capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
    count += 1
print('PASS', count, 'task-header/status cases including the exact captured offline log')
